title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

description:

RightWalk's work in Gujarat depends on how well we are trusted by the government system, industry, donors, NGOs and communities on the ground. This role owns that trust. The Manager – Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships is the person who ensures RightWalk's PMU is seen by government counterparts, establishments, industry and civil society as a credible, dependable, high-integrity partner — not just a project vendor.

This is a high-ownership role, not a coordination or liaison function. The person is fully accountable for the stakeholder ecosystem that determines whether RightWalk's programs in Gujarat land with government buy-in, industry participation, and community trust — expected to originate strategy, make independent judgment calls on engagement, and drive outcomes rather than simply execute instructions. Reporting to the PMU Head – Gujarat, this role owns the connective layer between the PMU's program delivery and the external ecosystem it depends on.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Stakeholder Relationship Ownership**

* Own and build strong working relationships with government departments, establishments & industry, donors, NGOs, and community groups across Gujarat.
* Own all external stakeholder communication on behalf of the PMU — timely, professional, and consistent, without needing to be directed.
* Represent RightWalk at government meetings, industry forums, and community events, building and personally standing behind the organisation's credibility.
* Independently identify, pursue and close opportunities for collaboration and strategic partnerships that strengthen program impact.

**2. Engagement Strategy, Planning & Execution**

* Own the design, implementation and monitoring of the Gujarat stakeholder engagement strategy, aligned with the PMU's program priorities.
* Own and maintain a live stakeholder map and engagement tracker — who matters, why, and what the relationship status is — as a single source of truth for the PMU.
* Take end-to-end ownership of workshops, roundtables and forums — agenda setting, logistics, and follow-through — ensuring each engagement delivers a clear outcome.
* Ensure engagement is inclusive and sustained, not transactional — built for long-term trust rather than one-off wins.

**3. Advisory & Internal Collaboration**

* Advise the PMU Head – Gujarat, Project Managers, and the Steering Committee on engagement strategy, and take the lead on flagging stakeholder risks early.
* Own the briefing of internal teams ahead of stakeholder meetings, translating stakeholder context into actionable guidance.
* Anticipate stakeholder concerns and potential friction points, and take the initiative to resolve them before they become the PMU's problem.

**4. Reporting & Documentation**

* Own the inputs for weekly and monthly reports to the Project Board, government counterparts, establishments/industry, and donors.
* Maintain a clear, auditable record of all stakeholder interactions, and be personally accountable for its accuracy.
* Define and own engagement effectiveness metrics, and use them to sharpen the approach over time.
* Own the preparation of reports, decks and briefing material for stakeholders and leadership.

**5. Partnership Development & Resource Mobilisation**

* Own the identification and cultivation of new partnerships with donors, industry, NGOs and government programs in Gujarat, driving them from first conversation to agreement.
* Take the lead on resource mobilisation efforts that strengthen the PMU's delivery capacity, working the relationship rather than waiting to be asked.
* Co-create programs and initiatives with partners in line with RightWalk's organisational goals.
* Continuously and independently scout for opportunities that expand RightWalk's visibility and credibility in the state.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — YEAR 1**

* A live, accurate stakeholder map exists for Gujarat, covering government, industry, donor and NGO relationships, with clear ownership and engagement status.
* RightWalk is a known, trusted name among key government counterparts and industry stakeholders relevant to the PMU's mandate.
* At least one new partnership or resource-mobilisation opportunity is identified and progressed with a donor, industry or government body.
* Stakeholder engagement plans are running on a predictable cadence — not ad hoc — with documented outcomes from each major forum or workshop.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Program design or delivery — this role enables delivery through relationships, it does not run the program itself.
* Strategic communications, media relations or public narrative — that sits with the Strategic Communications function.
* Overall donor strategy or fundraising targets — this role owns partnership cultivation and resource-mobilisation opportunities in Gujarat, not the organisation's fundraising strategy.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience: 4–7 years in stakeholder engagement, partnerships, or institutional relations within the development sector.
* Results-driven and proactive, comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal, networking and people-management skills, with the ability to engage credibly across government, industry and community groups.
* Confident working independently, able to anticipate challenges, and deliver quality work under tight timelines.
* Professional or working proficiency in Gujarati is required for effective engagement with state-level stakeholders and communities.
* Motivated by social justice, equity and systemic change, and energised by fast-paced, impact-driven environments.

**Core Values We Expect You to Embody**

* Integrity & Ethics: Do what's right, always.
* Ownership & Excellence: Take full charge, no excuses.
* Resilience & Audacity: Be fearless, even when it's hard.
* Empathy & End-User First: Listen, understand, and design what matters most.
